channel.title: Live: MOTD FIFA World Cup 2026
channel.desc: Live coverage as Algeria play Austria in their final Group J match at Kansas City Stadium. Algeria have made it out of the group stage just once in four previous appearances, taking eventual champions Germany into extra time in the last 16 in 2014. These are their first finals since then. They are due to be captained by former Leicester and Manchester City winger Riyad Mahrez.
